blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Romblon State University (RSU) will implement a three-day work-from-home arrangement for its faculty and staff from Tuesday (November 3) to Thursday (November 5) to promote economic efficiency and work-life balance. In an advisory, the state university said the arrangement would be implemented under Office of the University President Memorandum No. 154-00, series of 2026. Faculty and staff will continue performing their duties remotely to ensure institutional productivity and the uninterrupted delivery of essential services. Classes will also continue through synchronous or asynchronous learning modalities to avoid disruptions in instruction while considering the welfare of the university community. Job […]...
